scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @corepos/shared-types && npm run build -w @corepos/validation
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:packages && npm run db:migrate -w @corepos/api
scripts.db:normalize-roles: npm run build:packages && npm run db:normalize-roles -w @corepos/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @corepos/shared-types && npm run build -w @corepos/validation && npm run build -w @corepos/api && npm run build -w @corepos/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @corepos/shared-types && npm run build -w @corepos/validation && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
